verdict.rationale: The evidence pack includes several items sourced from a public GitHub repository (github.com/ollama/ollama), which suggests the source is publicly readable. However, no evidence states the license or confirms that the repository holds the full product source rather than only a README. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement, confirmation that the full source is in the repo, and independent corroboration of the license terms.
